prompt:
Warm painterly storybook illustration matching the soft flat shading, brushwork, gentle light and palette of the first reference image (olive and forest green, warm wood, turmeric orange, steel grey, cream). The main character is the SAME young man as in the second reference image: an Indian man in his mid-twenties with short wavy dark hair, warm brown skin and a clean-shaven friendly face, drawn in the same simple storybook style, wearing a plain heather-grey crew-neck t-shirt. No text, no lettering, no logos, no brand marks, no readable screens. Wide landscape composition.
The left 48% of the frame is a calm, empty, softly lit cream tiled kitchen wall with nothing on it at all, reserved for notes and text. On the right: in his small apartment kitchen in the evening, the young man stands at a two-burner stove, smiling and stirring a kadai of paneer sabzi with a wooden spatula, steam rising. A smartphone leans against the backsplash beside him. A steel masala dabba, a block of butter on a small plate and a few eggs on the counter, a potted herb on the windowsill, warm pendant light.
